title.en: What keeping widening needs, and what carries it
title.zh: 持续扩大需要什么，以及承载它者

statement.en: A course keeping widening by name with fixed finite requirements needs unbounded stock, fed from beyond; under upkeep, renewers multiply; passing support makes opened by the opened a recency bound; nothing keeps opening along passing of support under the World premises if requirements never loosen.
statement.zh: 按名持续扩大、需求有限而固定的进程超出一切界并由外而喂；有维持时其更新者增多；支撑之传递把由已开者所开定为近期之界；在世界前提且需求永不放松时，沿支撑之传递无一持续开出。

laws.en: The gain bridge. A course keeping widening by name on the actual levels from T, every formation supported from T on requiring at one need only members of a list cs, lists for every n some n steps from T with pairwise distinct configurations of cs. By Novelty's list form the stock of cs exceeds every bound, and rises, at arbitrarily late steps, deciding only the order of numbers at finitely many steps. A restatement.
laws.zh: 增益之桥。自 T 起于实有水平上按名持续扩大、自 T 起每一受支撑构成只需列表 cs 之成员（需求为一）的进程，对每一 n 列出自 T 起的 n 步，cs 于其上构型两两不同。故依 Novelty 的列表形式，cs 之存量于任意晚的步上超出一切界并上升。只于有限多列出之步上判定数之大小。重述。

laws.en: Fed from beyond. Under the first law, cs without repetition, at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives cs net or cs is not closed; with balance on cs from a step as well, it is not closed at arbitrarily late steps. A finite, closed world balanced on all its conditions under the first law has no course keeping widening by name with what its formations require so fixed. A restatement.
laws.zh: 由外而喂。第一律下、cs 无重复时，于任意晚的步上其余部分净给予 cs，或 cs 不闭合；若自某步起亦在 cs 上平衡，则于任意晚的步上不闭合。第一律下于全部条件上平衡的有限闭合世界，没有其构成所需如此固定而按名持续扩大的进程。重述。

laws.en: Takers multiply. Under upkeep, every formation supported from T on taking part and taking at least a unit a step from cs, a course keeping widening by name has more takers of cs without end. They are counted from below: a list without repetition, each member in another list with a positive quantity, is no longer than the count of that list's entries with a positive quantity, with no decision of equality.
laws.zh: 取用者增多。有维持时（自 T 起每一受支撑构成皆参与，且每步自 cs 至少取一单位），按名持续扩大的进程，其取 cs 者无尽增多。自下计之：无重复的列表，若其每一成员皆在另一列表中且量为正，则其长不超过该列表量为正之条目数，不判定相等。

laws.en: Renewers multiply. With cs balanced on from a step, a course keeping widening by name under upkeep has its replenishment bounded from no step on; with each entry giving cs at most g a step, so are its renewers. Takers and renewers count entries of the present list, with repetition, so they count formations only where the list repeats none. A restatement.
laws.zh: 更新者增多。自某步起在 cs 上平衡时，有维持而按名持续扩大的进程，其补给自无一步起有界；若每一条目每步给予 cs 至多 g，其更新者亦然。取用者与更新者计当前列表之条目，含重复，故唯列表无重复处方计构成。重述。

laws.en: Opened by the opened within a recency bound, the form support passing on gives: gains of support recur, and every gain from step K on is given, up to double negation, on a rising condition the gainer requires, by a supported formation taking part that gained support within the K steps before. Gains before step K are exempt; within 0 holds of no flow, nor within any bound where nothing is supported from some step on.
laws.zh: 在一近期界内由已开者所开，即支撑之传递所给的形式：支撑之获得复现，且自第 K 步起每一获得，皆在双重否定下，于获得者所需且上升之条件上，由一参与的受支撑构成给予，该构成于此前 K 步内获得支撑。第 K 步之前的获得豁免；界为 0 时无流成立，自某步起无一受支撑处亦于任何界不成立。

laws.en: Its laws: brief supports give it; it is monotone in the bound; it gives the lagged form of a fixed origin; UE4's form at every origin gives it with bound one. With support decided, and what the gainer requires listed and decided, the giver and its step are found, no omniscience principle entering. Near-definitional.
laws.zh: 其律：支撑短暂即给出之；它对界单调；它给出固定起点的滞后形式；UE4 之形式于每一起点皆成立时给出界为一之此形式。支撑可判定、获得者所需被列出且可判定时，给予者及其步可被找到，不入任何全知原则。近乎定义。

laws.en: The map reads keeping. Read the web through what levels admit: nothing admitted is lost along a continuation from T exactly where the admitted pattern's line from every admitted occurrence never ends (不穷); by name, nothing lost gives 全守, and nothing is 全生成. Near-definitional.
laws.zh: 图谱读保持。经水平所纳读网：沿一延续自 T 起所纳无失，恰是所纳模式自每一被纳之出现起之线不穷；按名，无失给出全守，且无一全生成。近乎定义。

laws.en: The map reads carrying. Along carrying on or passing support, a carrying renewal (传) from a supported occurrence is exactly a passing of support, every gain of support is one up to double negation, and each successor comes with its case. Where no formation is supported at K + 1 consecutive steps, every supported endless line is 全生成, and 全生成 is 生成 on the grammar. It answers part of 02's open item.
laws.zh: 图谱读承载。沿“延续或传递支撑”，自受支撑之出现起的承载之更新（传）恰为支撑之传递，每一支撑之获得在双重否定下皆是，每一后继皆带其情形。无一构成连续 K + 1 步受支撑之处，每一受支撑之不穷之线皆全生成，且于文法上全生成即生成。部分回答 02 之未决项。

laws.en: If requirements never loosen, under the World premises what is supported at a step is, up to double negation, linked along carrying on or passing support to something supported at any earlier step. So along every continuation containing it the levels exceed from no step to a later one, and nothing keeps opening or widening there: on both readings used, 全生成 and keeping widening do not hold together. Near-definitional.
laws.zh: 需求永不放松时，在世界前提下，任一步上受支撑者，在双重否定下，沿“延续或传递支撑”与任一更早步上受支撑者相连。故沿包含它的每一延续，水平从无一步到更晚之步超出，彼处无一持续开出或持续扩大：于所用两种读法上，全生成与持续扩大不并立。近乎定义。

laws.en: Witnesses on a ladder, formations climbing one condition, each new one needing a unit more: under the first law they meet the gain bridge's premises together, the family open at every step; under upkeep they meet those of renewers multiplying together, the renewers bounded from no step on. Dropping upkeep, capacity or balance, a flow with at most one renewer a step keeps widening by name.
laws.zh: 梯之见证（攀一条件的诸构成，每一新者多需一单位）：第一律下它们共同满足增益之桥的前提，该族每步皆开放；有维持时共同满足更新者增多的前提，更新者自无一步起有界。去掉维持、容量或平衡，每步至多一更新者的流按名持续扩大。

laws.en: Witnesses on UE4's closed cycle: it keeps opening by name with stock one throughout, closed and never given from beyond, its renewers bounded, so both multiplying laws need nothing lost. It is opened by the opened within one, its supports brief, and along carrying on or passing support it is 全生成, hence 生成, at every supported occurrence while its levels exceed from no step to a later one: the exclusion's instance.
laws.zh: UE4 闭环之见证：它按名持续开出，存量始终为一，闭合且从未自外受给，其更新者有界，故两条增多之律皆需无失。其支撑短暂，在界一内由已开者所开；沿“延续或传递支撑”，它于每一受支撑之出现皆全生成，故生成，而其水平从无一步到更晚之步超出：排除律之实例。

laws.en: Witnesses on UE4's opening chain: the rising course keeps widening by name with no finite family's stock passing its length, so a finite family is needed. The relay is opened by the opened within one and the single giver within no bound, the supports of both lasting: brevity is sufficient and not necessary, and needed for the single giver.
laws.zh: UE4 开出之链之见证：上升进程按名持续扩大，而无一有限族之存量超过其长，故需有限族。接力在界一内由已开者所开，单一给予者于任何界皆否，二者支撑皆持久：短暂充分而非必要，对单一给予者则必需。

laws.en: Witnesses that the two carrier forms are independent at a single origin: the lagged relay is opened by the opened within two and in UE4's form at no origin; the late single giver, formation 0 at step 0 and formation 1 after, is opened by the opened in UE4's form at origin 0 and within no bound. A change of class, not a relaxation.
laws.zh: 两种承载形式在单一起点上彼此独立之见证：滞后接力在界二内由已开者所开，而于任一起点皆不合 UE4 之形式；迟来的单一给予者（第 0 步为构成 0，此后为构成 1）于起点 0 合 UE4 之形式，而于任何界皆否。是类之改变，不是放宽。

laws.en: Witnesses on UE4's saturated and own-condition webs: with every support lasting, every line never ends and keeps and none is 全生成, so the map law needs brevity; the still flow is opened by the opened within no bound, and ranking by the recency form reverses widening as ranking by UE4's did; by name the rising course is kept and not 全生成; on the own-condition web no flow is opened by the opened within any bound.
laws.zh: UE4 饱和之网与自身条件之网之见证：每一支撑皆持久时，每一线皆不穷且保持，无一全生成，故图谱律需短暂；静止之流于任何界皆不由已开者所开，按近期形式排序逆转扩大，如按 UE4 之形式；按名上升进程得保持而不全生成；自身条件之网上无流于任何界由已开者所开。

laws.en: Witnesses that fixed needs and the first law are needed: on a loosening web, needs falling toward one, a course keeps widening by name with stock one throughout; with a source giving from nothing, a finite balanced world keeps widening by name, its family closed and never given from beyond, so without the first law the finite-world law fails.
laws.zh: 固定需求与第一律皆必需之见证：于放松之网上（需求降向一），一进程按名持续扩大而存量始终为一；有自无而给的源时，有限而平衡的世界按名持续扩大，其族闭合且从未自外受给，故无第一律则有限世界之律不成立。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each law states its premises: the first law (nothing comes from nothing), balance on the family from a step, upkeep, bounded giving per entry, brief supports, or three World premises (balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support) with requirements never loosening, which is not a World premise.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每一律陈其前提：第一律（无不自无生）、自某步起在族上平衡、维持、每条目给予有界、支撑短暂，或三条世界前提（平衡、只有活跃者给予、活跃需支撑）加上需求永不放松，后者非世界前提。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete steps; natural-number amounts, on which passing every bound depends (in a dense order needs approaching a limit could support ever more formations at a bounded stock; argued, not proved in Lean); admission by name over a fixed type of formations; takers and renewers as entries of the present list.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选：离散之步；自然数之量，超出一切界依赖于此（于稠密之序中，趋近一极限的需求可在有界存量下支撑越来越多的构成；此为论证，未在 Lean 中证明）；在固定的构成类型上按名而纳；取用者与更新者为当前列表之条目。

does_not_show.en: A comparison of two courses: no law here compares two, so the second-order direction of 生生 stays open and eventual widening's lag stays undecided.
does_not_show.zh: 两个进程之比较：此处无一律比较两者，故生生的二阶方向仍未定，最终扩大之滞后仍未决。

does_not_show.en: That 02's open item is answered: on both readings used 全生成 and keeping widening do not hold together, and 生成 is read on the World only where 全生成 gives it.
does_not_show.zh: 02 之未决项已答：于所用两种读法上全生成与持续扩大不并立，且生成只于全生成给出之处在世界上被读。

does_not_show.en: A third part against the TAP equation, assembly theory or Jones 1995: each leaves conservation or upkeep out as stated, and its own variants or neighbours supply it.
does_not_show.zh: 对 TAP 方程、组装理论或 Jones 1995 的第三部分：各者所述皆略去守恒或维持，而其自身之变体或近邻补之。

does_not_show.en: That the first carrier form was merely too strict: at a single origin the two forms are independent.
does_not_show.zh: 承载之初形只是过严：在单一起点上两种形式彼此独立。

does_not_show.en: That renewers count formations where the present list repeats one; growth by kinds not given in advance; which actual courses meet the premises.
does_not_show.zh: 当前列表有重复时更新者即计构成；非预先给定之种类的增长；哪些实有进程满足这些前提。

detail.en: A closed cycle keeps opening by name with stock one throughout and is 全生成 with no widening (ClosedCycle.bounded_while_opening, ClosedCycle.generation_without_widening).
detail.zh: 闭环按名持续开出而存量始终为一，且全生成而无扩大（ClosedCycle.bounded_while_opening、ClosedCycle.generation_without_widening）。

detail.en: With a source giving from nothing, a finite balanced world keeps widening by name, closed (Source.from_nothing); on a loosening web a course keeps widening with stock one (Loosening.bounded_while_widening).
detail.zh: 有自无而给的源时，有限而平衡的世界按名持续扩大且闭合（Source.from_nothing）；于放松之网上一进程以存量一持续扩大（Loosening.bounded_while_widening）。

detail.en: A late single giver is opened by the opened in the first form and within no recency bound; a lagged relay within two and in the first form at no origin (OpeningChain.forms_independent).
detail.zh: 迟来的单一给予者合初形，而于任何近期界皆否；滞后接力于界二内合，而于任一起点皆不合初形（OpeningChain.forms_independent）。

correspondence.en: Open systems (Prigogine; Schrödinger) and finite recurrence; open-ended evolution measured against an isolated system's recurrence (Bedau and others 2000; Adams and others 2017); the TAP equation (Cortês and others), whose logistic variant limits innovation, and assembly theory (Sharma and others 2023), which notes mass constraints, so the gain bridge is the conservation they leave out as stated; autocatalytic sets, food-generated (Steel 2000; Hordijk and Steel 2004; Vasas and others 2012); maintenance and depreciation, break-even investment (Solow 1956) and the maintenance coefficient (Pirt 1965), which semi-endogenous growth (Jones 1995) leaves out as stated; demography with a maximal lifespan for the uniform form; biogenesis for the exclusion. Graded in development/ue7-what-keeps-widening/NOTE.md and REVIEW-UE7.md; the readings are the AI's.
correspondence.zh: 开放系统（Prigogine；Schrödinger）与有限回复；以孤立系统之回复衡量的开放式演化（Bedau 等 2000；Adams 等 2017）；TAP 方程（Cortês 等），其逻辑斯谛变体限制创新，与组装理论（Sharma 等 2023），其注意到质量约束，故增益之桥即其所述略去之守恒；自催化集，由食物生成（Steel 2000；Hordijk 与 Steel 2004；Vasas 等 2012）；维持与折旧，收支平衡之投资（Solow 1956）与维持系数（Pirt 1965），半内生增长（Jones 1995）所述略去之；一致形式对应有最大寿命的人口学；排除律对应生源说。分级见 development/ue7-what-keeps-widening/NOTE.md 与 REVIEW-UE7.md；读法皆 AI 之读。

detail.en: What a course keeps reachable: covering implies inclusion now, so it ranks a range that keeps widening above one wider now that starts a course only with a lag, and not every such pair.
detail.zh: 进程保持可达者：覆盖蕴含当下之包含，故仅带滞后时把持续扩大之范围排在起进程且当下更宽者之上，且非每一此种对。
